data.name: AbsolutePathRequired
data.value: Local acceptance requires the explicitly configured absolute artifact/results path. Rebuild the test project with AotDllPath.

data.name: RelativePathRequired
data.value: Sandbox acceptance requires a relative path contained within the test application directory. Rebuild with ComAcceptanceSandbox=true.

data.name: InvalidNativeIdentity
data.value: The artifact must be a matching-architecture native PE and its SHA256 must match the packaged official publication.

data.name: ExitArguments
data.value: Expected root seconds filter, or --full root seconds. Root and filtered expressions must not be blank.

data.name: ExitBudget
data.value: The supervision budget must be 1–120 seconds for filtered mode or 1–1500 seconds for full mode.
